author: VanZandtVS
body:
Valhallan Dissonance now applies a portion of our Redline passive to player stats in addition to its original effect on pet stats.  It's a big defensive buff in general, and also let's Base Beo to weave some damage abilities into our rotation in between keeping up our buffs.

Base Beo is getting inherent follower AI and Beo Auriga is getting 2 levels of improved follower ai.

Bestial Bonds, our new passive, gives the followers 3 tiers of effects based on their "Family".  

For example:  

Dragon family pets currently give you 20% lightning resist at Bond lvl 1.  

Bond lvl 2 gives them 10% of your att / mag rating as extra att / mag stats.  

Bond lvl 3 is an additional 10% att / mag rating from the player's stats, plus Wyvern Speed 3, Wyrm's Song, and Wyrm's Seal as usable skills.

Wyvern Speed 3 and Wyrm's Song being usable by the pet frees up 2 player skill slots, which is huge QoL.  

Wyrm Seal isn't *great* damage, and we were concerned it would just dilute the move pool, but Odie coded it so that the extra skills granted by Bond's only get used if your follower would otherwise take no action that turn, so it's literally just free damage.  There's currently some issues with these extra skills being used if your followers have 100% actrate, but that's what the beta is for.

All in all, big improvements so far, and Odie's still tweaking numbers.
